about: Gold set B's sample (#3): ids only, never text. scripts/gold-b/sample.ts draws it from Europe PMC with this plan: the papers the base query finds, a few for each hard case first (each from its query, in the seed's order, kept if scripts/gold-b/draw.ts's check finds the case in its text), then the rest shared across the years in proportion. Run the script without --write to draw again and compare. The sheet lists the same papers in sheetOrder.
base: (ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research U.K." OR ACK_FUND:"CRUK") AND NOT GRANT_AGENCY:"Cancer Research UK" AND FIRST_PDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 2026-11-08]

hardCases.query: ((ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research U.K." OR ACK_FUND:"CRUK") AND NOT GRANT_AGENCY:"Cancer Research UK" AND FIRST_PDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 2026-11-08]) AND (COMP_INT:"Cancer Research UK" OR COMP_INT:"CRUK")

hardCases.query: ((ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research U.K." OR ACK_FUND:"CRUK") AND NOT GRANT_AGENCY:"Cancer Research UK" AND FIRST_PDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 2026-11-08]) AND (ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK Centre" OR ACK_FUND:"CRUK Centre" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK Manchester Institute" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK Beatson Institute" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK Scotland Institute" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK Cambridge Institute")
